**CRITICAL**: This project uses **Podman Compose** (not Docker Compose). Always use `podman compose` commands. All PHP commands must run inside the `app` container. **CRITICAL**: This project uses a **custom test runner**, NOT PHPUnit. The test runner is implemented in [src/Test.php](src/Test.php).
podman compose up -d
podman compose exec app php ajo test
podman compose exec app php ajo test --parallel
podman compose exec app php ajo test --coverage
podman compose exec app php ajo test:list
podman compose exec app php ajo migrate
podman compose exec app php ajo jobs:work
podman compose exec app php ajo help
podman compose exec app sh
Use `Test::suite()` and `Test::case()`; names direct present tense, avoid “should”. **CRITICAL**: This project is **pre-release**. There are **no backward compatibility constraints**. **Always update tests**. Keep code DRY, simple, readable, robust, clever, performant; prefer closures, match, array functions, guard clauses, `??`, `?:`; avoid over-engineering. **IMPORTANT**: This project has **Xdebug 3.4.6** installed and configured in the `app` container. Use the **xdebug-inspect skill**.
/skill xdebug-inspect
podman compose exec app php debug_<issue>.php
